user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for ChatGPT search features.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Landing pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training generative AI foundation models.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited during user-initiated requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Enhances utility and safety of generative AI models by collecting web content.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content for user-initiated queries in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Navigates web to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google Search indexes and performs general product crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and image features across Google Search.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content across the web.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content specifically for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Google News surfaces, including news.google.com and the Google News app.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shopping and commerce content.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools and diagnostics.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and team fetches.
user_agents.scope: Non-product-specific internal research and development fetches of publicly accessible content.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs for non-product-specific crawling.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs for non-product-specific crawling.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes site owner crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Gemini models and grounding in Vertex AI.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI API.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and indexes web content.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for search and contextual AI output in Apple products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls data usage for training generative AI foundation models across Apple products.
user_agents.scope: Determines whether content crawled by Applebot is used for training foundation models.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content on Meta apps to display titles, descriptions, and thumbnails.
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for improving advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and business products.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content for foundation model training and product improvement.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: User-requested link fetches to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls host-level web pages to improve Amazon services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawl content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetch live web information to support user-initiated queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information for user actions; does not train generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions may not follow all robots.txt directives.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Automated crawling of a sample of the web via HTTP GET requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or request addition to the opt-out registry.
